datasets.name: today
queryLines: SELECT model_name, owner_team, bucket, risk_tier, status, health_score, red_metrics, amber_metrics FROM demo_unified_model_monitoring.hub_gold.fact_model_health_daily WHERE metric_date = (SELECT max(metric_date) FROM demo_unified_model_monitoring.hub_gold.fact_model_health_daily) ORDER BY health_score

datasets.name: kpis
queryLines: SELECT count(*) AS models, sum(CASE WHEN status='red' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS red, sum(CASE WHEN status='amber' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS amber, sum(CASE WHEN status='green' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS green, round(avg(health_score),1) AS avg_health FROM demo_unified_model_monitoring.hub_gold.fact_model_health_daily WHERE metric_date = (SELECT max(metric_date) FROM demo_unified_model_monitoring.hub_gold.fact_model_health_daily)

datasets.name: inventory
queryLines:
SELECT d.model_name, d.owner_team, d.risk_tier, d.bucket, d.lane, d.current_version, d.source_workspace,
                    max(h.metric_date) AS last_monitored, sum(h.n_red) AS red_metric_days_30d, sum(h.n_amber) AS amber_metric_days_30d
                    FROM demo_unified_model_monitoring.hub_gold.dim_model d LEFT JOIN demo_unified_model_monitoring.hub_gold.fact_model_health_daily h ON d.model_id = h.model_id AND h.metric_date >= date_sub(current_date(), 30)
                    GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY red_metric_days_30d DESC

datasets.name: alerts
queryLines: SELECT metric_date, model_name, owner_team, display_name AS metric, alert_type, to_status, round(eval_value,4) AS value, round(threshold,4) AS threshold, message FROM demo_unified_model_monitoring.hub_gold.fact_alerts ORDER BY metric_date DESC LIMIT 200

datasets.name: breach_by_category
queryLines: SELECT category, model_name, count(*) AS breach_days FROM demo_unified_model_monitoring.hub_gold.fact_metric_health_daily WHERE status IN ('amber','red') AND metric_date >= date_sub(current_date(), 30) GROUP BY ALL

datasets.name: pd_perf
queryLines: SELECT metric_date, display_name AS metric, eval_value FROM demo_unified_model_monitoring.hub_gold.fact_metric_health_daily WHERE model_id='pd_counterparty_default' AND contract_name IN ('accuracy','precision','recall','f1_macro')

datasets.name: pd_drift
queryLines: SELECT metric_date, display_name AS metric, value FROM demo_unified_model_monitoring.hub_gold.fact_metric_health_daily WHERE model_id='pd_counterparty_default' AND contract_name IN ('data_drift_psi','data_drift_js','label_drift_js','concept_drift_score')

datasets.name: pd_fair
queryLines: SELECT metric_date, slice_value AS country, value AS approval_rate FROM demo_unified_model_monitoring.hub_gold.fact_metric_slice_daily WHERE model_id='pd_counterparty_default' AND contract_name='approval_rate_gap'

datasets.name: fc_err
queryLines: SELECT metric_date, display_name AS metric, value FROM demo_unified_model_monitoring.hub_gold.fact_metric_health_daily WHERE model_id='trade_volume_forecast' AND contract_name IN ('mae','rmse')

datasets.name: rag_quality
queryLines: SELECT metric_date, display_name AS metric, eval_value FROM demo_unified_model_monitoring.hub_gold.fact_metric_health_daily WHERE model_id='credit_policy_rag' AND contract_name IN ('groundedness','context_relevance','response_relevance','precision_at_k','recall_at_k')

datasets.name: safety
queryLines: SELECT metric_date, model_name, eval_value AS safety_violation_rate FROM demo_unified_model_monitoring.hub_gold.fact_metric_health_daily WHERE contract_name='safety_violation_rate'

datasets.name: agent_gov
queryLines: SELECT metric_date, display_name AS metric, eval_value FROM demo_unified_model_monitoring.hub_gold.fact_metric_health_daily WHERE model_id='rm_client_brief_agent' AND contract_name IN ('permission_compliance_rate','approval_adherence_rate','recovery_success_rate','escalation_appropriateness','tool_accuracy')

datasets.name: cost
queryLines: SELECT metric_date, model_name, value AS usd FROM demo_unified_model_monitoring.hub_gold.fact_metric_health_daily WHERE contract_name IN ('cost_per_request','cost_per_successful_query')

datasets.name: explorer
queryLines: SELECT model_name, display_name AS metric, category, round(value,4) AS value, round(eval_value,4) AS evaluated, round(amber_threshold,4) AS amber, round(red_threshold,4) AS red, status, source FROM demo_unified_model_monitoring.hub_gold.fact_metric_health_daily WHERE metric_date = (SELECT max(metric_date) FROM demo_unified_model_monitoring.hub_gold.fact_metric_health_daily) ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'red' THEN 0 WHEN 'amber' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, model_name

datasets.name: triage_kpi
queryLines: SELECT owner_team, open_alerts, open_p1, unacknowledged, mtta_hours, mttr_hours, false_positive_rate FROM demo_unified_model_monitoring.hub_gold.fact_triage_kpis

datasets.name: triage_open
queryLines: SELECT priority, model_name, display_name AS metric, triage_status, assignee, metric_date, message FROM demo_unified_model_monitoring.hub_gold.fact_alert_triage WHERE triage_status IN ('open','acknowledged','investigating') ORDER BY priority, metric_date DESC

datasets.name: memory
queryLines: SELECT metric_date, display_name AS metric, eval_value FROM demo_unified_model_monitoring.hub_gold.fact_metric_health_daily WHERE model_id='rm_client_brief_agent' AND contract_name LIKE '%memory%'

lines: ## One place for every CIB model
Health across classical ML, RAG, agents and the shared LLM endpoint. Green = all metrics within thresholds; amber/red = at least one breach.
Inventory, ownership and breach history per model, with every status change logged.
Triage state is written by the app to Lakebase and synced here nightly. Memory metrics cover recall, grounding, conflicts, leakage and PII held in memory.
